name: Gmail
description: Search your inbox, read threads and draft replies.
note: Google asks for an OAuth client of your own: in Google Cloud, enable the Gmail API and its MCP service, create a Web application client, tick "Use this client for an AI-powered agent", and add Jizza's sign-in address as a redirect URI. Google's Workspace MCP servers are in its Developer Preview.

name: Google Calendar
description: See your calendars, events and when you are free.
note: Uses an OAuth client of your own, set up as for Gmail: enable the Calendar API and its MCP service, then add Jizza's sign-in address as a redirect URI.

name: Google Drive
description: Search, read and upload files in your Drive.
note: Uses an OAuth client of your own, set up as for Gmail: enable the Drive API and its MCP service, then add Jizza's sign-in address as a redirect URI.
